summary.caption: A character design sheet presents 5 separate views of one character on a plain white background. From left to right: 2 head-and-chest portraits (top to bottom: front portrait, right-facing profile portrait); 3 full-body views (left to right: full-body front view, full-body anatomical-left profile, full-body rear view). The depicted character: An adult female explorer with short dark-blue hair, amber eyes, a medium build and a small silver ear cuff on her anatomical left ear. The outfit: A muted green waist-length jacket, a cream shirt, charcoal trousers, fingerless brown gloves and brown ankle boots. Anime illustration with controlled linework and cel shading. The different views depict one consistent character, with matching identity, proportions, outfit colors, materials and anatomical asymmetries. The full-body depictions in each row have matching scale and aligned sole levels. Only the portions described in each view are visible; appearance details do not change the assigned viewpoint or crop. The surrounding space is blank, without sheet-level titles, panel labels, watermarks, drawn borders or alignment marks. Explicitly described lettering on a garment or accessory belongs only on that surface.
